description:
Workspace tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_workspaces: List every Draftless workspace (organization) the signed-in user belongs to, with their role in each (owner / admin / member / viewer) and w
- select_workspace: Set the active Draftless workspace (organization) for this MCP connector.
- get_workspace: Return detail for the active Draftless workspace (organization): name, your role, plan / subscription status, member count with a role break
- list_audit_events: List the audit trail of a shared workspace, newest first: members added or removed, role changes, approval requests and decisions, and chang
- get_webhook_secret: Get (auto-provisioning on first call) the HMAC signing secret Draftless uses to sign completion webhooks.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

title: Workspace
